beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Christian and Pliable walked on together across the fields beyond the city, talking all the way.

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: So tell me MORE about this Celestial City! Do the crowns come in rabbit sizes? Is there clover?
beats.say: So tell me more about this Celestial City! Do the crowns come in rabbit sizes? Is there clover?

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Ha! The book says there is no night there, and no tears… Careful, friend — the ground past those reeds looks soft.
beats.say: Ha! The book says there is no night there, and no tears... Careful, friend. The ground past those reeds looks soft.

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Soft, schmoft! With GLORY ahead, who has time to look down? Hop hop — race you to the far side!
beats.say: Soft, schmoft! With glory ahead, who has time to look down? Hop hop! Race you to the far side!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: But they were so busy dreaming of the golden city that they did not look where they were going…

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Wh—whoa! The ground — it is swallowing us! Hold fast, Pliable!
beats.say: Whoa! The ground! It is swallowing us! Hold fast, Pliable!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: GLUB—! Mud! In my EARS! In my WHISKERS! Christian, I am DISSOLVING!
beats.say: Glub! Mud! In my ears! In my whiskers! Christian, I am dissolving!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Is THIS the glorious happiness you spoke of?! Golden streets, you said! CROWNS, you said!
beats.say: Is this the glorious happiness you spoke of?! Golden streets, you said! Crowns, you said!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Courage, friend! If we press on together, the far bank cannot be—
beats.say: Courage, friend! If we press on together, the far bank cannot be...

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: FORWARD?! Into MORE of it?! Not for every crown in every city! Out of my way!
beats.say: Forward?! Into more of it?! Not for every crown in every city! Out of my way!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Blegh! Mud in my ears, mud in my whiskers, mud in places a gentle-rabbit shan't MENTION!
beats.say: Blegh! Mud in my ears, mud in my whiskers, mud in places a gentle rabbit shan't mention!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: If this bog is the FIRST step of your glorious journey, Christian, you may keep all the rest of it!
beats.say: If this bog is the first step of your glorious journey, Christian, you may keep all the rest of it!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Pliable, wait! The crowns and the city are still real! One muddy place does not change the truth!

beats.speaker: Pliable
beats.text: Then you may have my share of the crowns AND my share of the mud. I am going HOME. Farewell — and good luck to your poor back!
beats.say: Then you may have my share of the crowns, and my share of the mud. I am going home. Farewell! And good luck to your poor back!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: …And there he goes, hopping home. Then I will cross alone. There must be solid ground somewhere under this mud…
beats.say: And there he goes, hopping home. Oh dear. Then I will cross alone. There must be solid ground somewhere under this mud...

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: So Christian struggled on by himself. But the mud was deep, and his burden was so very heavy.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: The bank is right there — but I cannot climb it. This burden on my back drags me down and down…
beats.say: The bank is right there, but I cannot climb it. This burden on my back drags me down, and down...

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Is this how the journey ends? Stuck in deep mud when I can see the way out…?
beats.say: Is this how the journey ends? Stuck in deep mud, when I can see the way out?

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Just then, a kind voice called out across the marsh.

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: Hello there! Friend in the mud, how did you get stuck?

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: I fell in as I fled the City of Destruction — and this burden sinks me. I cannot reach the bank!
beats.say: I fell in as I fled the City of Destruction, and this burden sinks me. I cannot reach the bank!

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: I am called Help. But tell me — why did you not look for the Steps? Good solid stones lie through the very midst of this slough.
beats.say: I am called Help. But tell me, why did you not look for the Steps? Good solid stones lie through the very midst of this slough.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Fear chased me in so fast, I never thought to look down…
beats.say: Fear chased me in so fast, I never thought to look down...

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: So it goes with every pilgrim. Here — give me your paw!
beats.say: So it goes with every pilgrim. Here, give me your paw!

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: HEAVE!
beats.say: Heave!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Solid ground! Thank you, Help. I had nearly given up hope.
beats.say: Phew... Solid ground! Thank you, Help. I had nearly given up hope.

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: This is the Slough of Despond, friend. When a pilgrim first wakes to how lost he is, all his fears and doubts and discouragements come running — and they settle here, in this low place.
beats.say: This is the Slough of Despond, friend. When a pilgrim first wakes to how lost he is, all his fears and doubts and discouragements come running, and they settle here, in this low place.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: And Pliable… he struggled out on the side nearest home.
beats.say: And Pliable... he struggled out on the side nearest home.

beats.speaker: Help
beats.text: Many travellers turn back at the first patch of mud. But you made it through, burden and all. Keep going, Christian — the true Gate is not far now.
beats.say: Many travellers turn back at the first patch of mud. But you made it through, burden and all! Keep going, Christian. The true Gate is not far now.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: So Christian thanked Help, and went on his way, still dripping with mud, toward the shining light ahead.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: But just around the bend, a very fine gentleman in a tall black hat was waiting for him…
beats.say: But just around the bend, a very fine gentleman in a tall black hat was waiting for him...
